Privacy.metaTitle: Privacy and consent | Brand X Lucknow
Privacy.metaDescription: What Brand X collects when you enquire or book a test drive, who sees it, and how to stop messages.
Privacy.title: Privacy and consent
Privacy.lead: What happens to your details, in plain words.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your name, mobile number, the language you prefer, your message, and the car or test-drive slot you asked about. We also keep the time you agreed to be contacted.

why.title: Why we collect it
why.body: Only to answer your enquiry or arrange your test drive. We do not sell your details or pass them to advertisers.

who.title: Who can see it
who.body: The consultant your enquiry is assigned to, and the dealership's admins. It is never shown on the website. On used-car pages the registration number is partly hidden until you buy.

ai.title: AI and your enquiry
ai.body: A consultant may use an AI tool to summarise your message and draft a reply. It sees your message, the car, the city and our listed prices. It never sees your name, number or email, and a consultant reads and approves every reply before it goes out.

messages.title: Messages
messages.body: With your agreement, we may contact you by phone, WhatsApp or SMS about your enquiry. In this demo no real message is sent. Every message carries a link to stop them.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You can stop all messages at any time on the Stop messages page. You can also ask to see, correct or delete your details by writing to privacy@brandx.example. This follows India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

consent.title: Consent
consent.body: We ask for your agreement before every enquiry and booking, in plain language, and the box is never ticked for you.

Privacy.note: Brand X is a fictional brand, and every name, number and price on this site is sample data.
